name: Police Phase B - Restart Persistence Readback
description: After the serving V3 process restarts, an ordinary player can authenticate and read the persisted wanted state created by three successful lawful port robberies.

tests.name: Restart: ordinary player sees wanted state after fresh login
Restart: authoritative PostgreSQL row retains wanted state

data.sql: SELECT s.suspicion,s.wanted_level FROM cluster_player_status s JOIN cluster_sectors cs ON cs.cluster_id=s.cluster_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=s.player_id AND p.sector_id=cs.sector_id WHERE s.player_id=@{robbery_restart_player_player_id};
